dialogues.speaker: Late that night
dialogues.text: David was closing his laptop when Amara called. A web developer who believed every system could be decoded, he had no answer for the fear in her voice. Her son, Ethan, was missing.

dialogues.speaker: Before this night
dialogues.text: Amara and Victor had ended a long relationship before she met Ethan's father, a wealthy man. He provided for Amara and their child. He was now dead, but the future he had secured for them remained.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Victor thought I would return after Ethan's father died. I chose you instead. He keeps saying everything I have is because of him. Now he has taken my child, David.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: Ethan is your son, Amara. Neither your future nor your love belongs to Victor. Tell me exactly what happened. We will work from what we know.

dialogues.speaker: Victor
dialogues.text: A video opens on David's phone. 'I made her what she is,' Victor says. 'That rich man is gone. You think you can decode your way into my place? Follow the trail. Let us see who gets remembered.'

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Ethan's father wanted him safe. Victor wants everyone to owe him. Please, David. Bring my baby home.

choices.label: Call the police
choices.impact: Bring a formal investigator into the search. Detective Morris can secure evidence and coordinate help.
choices.response: David calls the police. Detective Morris answers: 'Tell me where Amara last saw Ethan. We will preserve the scene while you follow the lead.'
choices.speaker: Detective Morris

choices.label: Trace Victor's signal
choices.impact: David examines the message's technical trail while Amara supplies the context only she knows. They begin without police support.
choices.response: David saves the original message and checks its delivery records. Amara points out a detail from Victor's old routines. Together, they find a first lead.
choices.speaker: David

choices.label: Go after Victor alone
choices.impact: David follows the physical trail without police backup. He must check his conclusions and keep Amara informed.
choices.response: David sends Amara his location, closes the laptop and follows the prints. Victor expects a rival chasing glory. David is going for Amara's child.
choices.speaker: David

metadata.notes: Opening suspense scene and choice for the first playable investigation.
metadata.canon: Ethan is Amara's child; David is her partner, not his biological father.
